## Checked

- [ ] `node ~/.config/apsis/tests/run.js` passes, and the shell tests for the parts I touched
- [ ] Tried it on a running session, and `apsis doctor` is clean
- [ ] Every new or changed file starts with the two line header (what it does, then `Edit:`), and has no other comments
- [ ] New files were added by name, and nothing personal is in (weather.conf, face.png, hypr custom.lua or monitors.lua)
- [ ] A line in `.config/apsis/CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased
- [ ] If it changes what the README pictures show: `sh ~/.config/apsis/readme/render/render.sh`
